morning_evening.name: Morning Remembrance
morning_evening.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
morning_evening.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal mulku lillahi wal hamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer
morning_evening.translation: We have entered the morning and the entire kingdom belongs to Allah, all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things competent.
morning_evening.virtue: Whoever says this morning will be protected until evening

morning_evening.name: Evening Remembrance
morning_evening.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
morning_evening.transliteration: Amsaina wa amsal mulku lillahi wal hamdu lillah...
morning_evening.translation: We have entered the evening and the entire kingdom belongs to Allah...

sleeping_waking.name: Before Sleeping
sleeping_waking.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

sleeping_waking.name: Upon Waking
sleeping_waking.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
sleeping_waking.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
sleeping_waking.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it, and to Him is the resurrection.

eating_drinking.name: After Eating
eating_drinking.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَٰذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
eating_drinking.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
eating_drinking.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it to me without any strength or power on my part.

leaving_home.name: When Leaving Home
leaving_home.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
leaving_home.transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'ala Allah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
leaving_home.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, there is no power or strength except with Allah.

leaving_home.name: Entering Home
leaving_home.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلَجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
leaving_home.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khairal mawlaji wa khairal makhraji, bismillahi walajna wa bismillahi kharajna wa 'alallahi rabbina tawakkalna
leaving_home.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the best entrance and the best exit. In Allah's name we enter and in Allah's name we leave, and upon our Lord we rely.

prayer_mosque.name: Entering Mosque
prayer_mosque.translation: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

prayer_mosque.name: Leaving Mosque
prayer_mosque.translation: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.

protection.name: Ayat-ul-Kursi
protection.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ...
protection.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal hayyul qayyoom...
protection.translation: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence...

protection.name: Last Two Verses of Surah Al-Baqarah
protection.arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ...
protection.transliteration: Amanar rasulu bima unzila ilayhi mir rabbihi wal mu'minun...
protection.translation: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers...

parents_children.name: For Parents
parents_children.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.

parents_children.name: For Children
parents_children.translation: My Lord, grant me [children] from among the righteous.

sickness_health.name: Visiting the Sick
sickness_health.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ، طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
sickness_health.translation: Don't worry, it will be a purification, if Allah wills.

sickness_health.name: When Feeling Pain
sickness_health.arabic: أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، اشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
sickness_health.transliteration: Adhhibil ba'sa rabban nas, ishfi wa antash shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uka, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama
sickness_health.translation: Remove the harm, O Lord of mankind, heal [me], for You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves no disease.

travel.name: Starting Journey
travel.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
travel.transliteration: Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun
travel.translation: Exalted is the One who has subjected this to us, for we could never have done it [by ourselves]. And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return.

forgiveness.name: Sayyid-ul-Istighfar
forgiveness.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
forgiveness.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u bidhanbi, faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh dhunuba illa ant
forgiveness.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant. I am faithful to my covenant with You as much as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favors upon me and I acknowledge my sins. Forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

general.name: Jannah (Paradise)
general.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
general.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal jannata wa a'udhu bika minan nar
general.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire.

general.name: Comprehensive Dua
general.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
general.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid dunya hasanatan wa fil akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban nar
general.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
